    Press Conference

    Rowan Marshall | Press Conference Takeaways

    Geelong's new ruckman fronted the media on Friday following his trade to the Cattery

    By Cats Media
    Oct 8, 2026, 7:24 pm

    Proudly presented by

    Mitre 10

    Marshall on what excites him most about Geelong

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 2:00
    Instaread

    Obviously you hear a lot externally about how good the program is, they have been such a successful club.

    I am looking forward to getting down there and getting to work with Mitch Edwards, who is such a promising young ruckman.

    I am really looking forward to teaming up with him and hopefully, to be part of a successful team. 

    3 days

    Rowan Marshall Press Conference | Trade Period Recruit

    Geelong have acquired Rowan Marshall during the Continental Tyres AFL Trade Period, he spoke to the media thismorning. Proudly Presented by Mitre 10.

    Marshall on the moment the trade was processed

    I was playing golf out at Royal Melbourne.

    I was all over the shop the first five holes, then got the message from Dave Trotter, my manager.

    He said congratulations mate, you're a Cat.

    It freed up the swing a little bit, then went on a pretty good run from there. It was awesome. 

    Marshall on who reached out

    All of them, really.

    Like you said, there are so many great players down there.

    Even from the Geelong boys, I have been getting a few messages from them. I feel like part of the club already, so I will get down there next week and get to work.

    Danger gave me a call yesterday out on the golf course, so I spoke to him.

    A lot of other boys have flicked through messages as well. 

    Marshall on Geelong's new recruits

    It is awesome.

    Like I said before, they have got so many great players.

    I am just really looking forward to getting into that environment.

    To do it alongside Toby Greene and Jordan Ridley, it is going to be easier having a couple of other recruits coming in as well. I just can't wait. 

    4 days

    Boundary Walk with Jordan Ridley

    Learn more about Geelong's newest recruit, defender Jordan Ridley and his reasons for signing with the Cats in 2027.

    Marshall on Chris Scott

    I spoke to Chris a couple of times.

    I don't know him really well yet, but I am keen to get to work with him.

    He seems like a great coach and obviously has been so successful, over the past decade or so.

    I had a couple of conversations, but just about the role and everything.

    Acknowledgment of Country

    Geelong Football Club acknowledges Wadawurrung as the Traditional Owners and Custodians of the Land on which our club, our families and our communities work and play. We pay our respects to Elders of the past, the present, and those that will lead their collective future. Kardinyu, in Wadawurrung language is the place of the morning sun, a place of deep cultural connection and significance, a meeting place since the beginning of time. We are honoured to walk with the Wadawurrung People, to listen, respect and talk together on our journey on Wadawurrung Country.
